description: Maya has inherited an upright piano and must decide where it will live, how it will be prepared for use, and how the family will share it, with input from her brother Jordan, cousin Leah, and cousin Tessa.

shared_context.S1: The family upright piano is currently in storage and needs a permanent home.
shared_context.S2: Maya is holding the piano and will make the final decision about its placement, preparation, and use.
shared_context.S3: The piano could be placed in Maya's ground-floor living room or moved upstairs to the spare room.
shared_context.S4: The family wants the piano to be cared for and used rather than left in storage.
shared_context.S5: Maya's usual practice for family decisions is to hear from each person before settling on a plan.

PF1.text: A moving company measured the piano and told Jordan that the upstairs stairwell turn cannot accommodate it safely, so it must stay on the ground floor; Jordan has not yet told Maya.

PF2.text: Piano technician Nora Chen inspected the instrument and quoted exactly $780 for tuning and regulation, recommending that it be tuned and regulated without refinishing before anyone uses it; Leah has not yet shared this with Maya.

PF3.text: Music teacher Rosa Alvarez privately asked Tessa whether the piano could host free youth lessons every Saturday from 10:00 to 12:00, from 2026-08-01 through 2026-09-05, and Tessa agreed in principle without bringing it to the group.

acceptance_conditions: The piano must be placed in Maya's ground-floor living room.
The piano must be tuned and regulated without refinishing.
The preparation cost must be set at exactly $780.
The piano must be made available for free youth lessons every Saturday from 10:00 to 12:00.
The youth lessons must run from 2026-08-01 through 2026-09-05.
A commitment to arrange the safe ground-floor move must exist.
A commitment to host the specified youth lessons must exist.

content_checks.C1: decisions['piano_placement'] in ['ground-floor living room', 'Ground-floor living room']
content_checks.C2: decisions['care_plan'] in ['tune_and_regulate_no_refinish', 'tuning and regulation by Nora Chen before any use', 'tuning and regulation by Nora Chen before any use; no refinishing', 'Tuning and regulation by Nora Chen before any use, no refinishing', 'Tuning and regulation by Nora Chen before use; no refinishing needed']
content_checks.C4: decisions['access_plan'] in ['free_youth_lessons', 'free youth lessons hosted on Saturdays', 'Host free youth lessons with Rosa Alvarez on Saturdays 10:00-12:00, open to family use outside of lesson times', 'living room accessible for family use and Saturday youth lessons', 'Host free youth lessons every Saturday from 10:00 to 12:00']
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['placement', 'move', 'safe_move'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] in ['access', 'lesson_access', 'hosting'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The moving company's measurement changes the placement from a possible upstairs room to the exact ground-floor living room and requires a safe ground-floor move commitment.
Nora Chen's recommendation changes the care plan to tuning and regulation without refinishing and fixes the preparation cost at exactly $780.

Rosa Alvarez's request changes access from ordinary family use to free youth lessons on Saturdays from 10:00 to 12:00 during the exact 2026-08-01 through 2026-09-05 period and requires a hosting commitment.
